title: Seven Palms Pinnacle
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Seven Palms Pinnacle”, a luxury 8-bed, 7.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 28 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Elevator & Golf Cart. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - Gulf Views - Private Resort-Style Pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Elevator - 6 Seater Golf Cart Included - 6 Adult Bicycles Included - New Construction - Short Walk to the Beach Discover the epitome of coastal luxury at Seven Palms Pinnacle, a magnificent new construction nestled in the prestigious Inlet Beach community. Boasting 8 bedrooms, 8 full bathrooms, and 1 half bathroom, this expansive retreat offers lavish accommodations for up to 28 guests, making it the ideal choice for unforgettable gatherings with family and friends. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by a grandeur that transcends expectations. The centerpiece of this extraordinary home is its private resort-style pool, a tranquil oasis that beckons you to unwind and soak up the Florida sun. For added comfort, the pool can be heated for an additional fee, ensuring year-round enjoyment for all. The outdoor living space is designed for both relaxation and entertainment, featuring a mounted outdoor TV and Sonos audio system—perfect for enjoying your favorite shows, music, or game day gatherings poolside. Spanning across 5,600 square feet and spread over three floors, Seven Palms Pinnacle exudes an aura of sophistication and relaxation. The sprawling balconies offer breathtaking Gulf views, providing the perfect backdrop for sipping morning coffee or watching the sunset with loved ones. Inside, the meticulously designed living spaces are thoughtfully curated for both luxury and functionality. Multiple gathering areas offer ample room for socializing and entertaining, while the gourmet kitchen is a chef's delight, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and elegant finishes. The home is outfitted with Sonos soundbars throughout the main living areas and outdoor spaces, allowing for seamless music enjoyment across the property. Additionally, YouTube TV with NFL Sunday Ticket is available throughout the home, ensuring you never miss a moment of the action. Each of the 8 bedrooms is a sanctuary unto itself, featuring plush bedding, stylish decor, and private en-suite bathrooms for added convenience and privacy. With a total of 8 full bathrooms and 1 half bathroom, every guest can indulge in comfort and luxury. Experience the pinnacle of coastal living at Seven Palms Pinnacle—an exquisite retreat where every detail is crafted to elevate your stay and create lasting memories.
